notices.description: Additional information about potentially missing information or functionality due to transient errors.

items.description: A code identifying which downstream service was unavailable. Known values: OSDM (OSDM-gateway unavailable), PERSONALISATION (Personalisation service unavailable), INVENTORY (Inventory service unavailable), SEATING (Seating service unavailable). This list may be extended without a spec change.

AccommodationFacilityEnum.description: Subset of AccommodationFacilityEnumeration from NeTEx facility support.

items.description: Accommodation facility. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of AccommodationFacilityEnumeration at Entur. Related to but may include more than 'AccommodationFacilityEnum'.

AvailableFulfilmentMethod.description: Describes which fulfilmentMethods are available for an Offer,.

distributionRights.description: Says what the distribution channel is allowed to do with this offer. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of DistributionRightsEnumeration at Entur.

CappedDiscountOption.description: A discount might be given based on previous transactions if CappedDiscountRequest was specified. A cappingSpecification must be specified in the traveller attribute in the request to the search/ endpoints in order to receive a discount. Capping must also be enabled by the operator of the service journey.

CappingAlternative.description: An alternative is based on previous transactions might have a discount at the expense of setting the start date in the past.

selectableId.description: A pseudo random string that is used to select what alternative to use when purchasing an offer.

startDateTime.description: The start date of this alternative.

endDateTime.description: The end date of this alternative.

Carnet.description: Representation of a repeatable ticket, with an optional duration for each instance and an amount of times the ticket can be used.

amount.description: Number of times the ticket can be used.

duration.description: Validity duration of each use, formatted according to ISO-8601.

DiscountRightSummary.description: Summary of a sale discount right that has been applied to the fare product.

DurationEnum.description: Validity duration. Subset of UsageValidityTypeEnumeration from NeTEx usage parameter travel support.

FareClassEnum.description: A type of FareClass. Subset of FareClassEnumeration from NeTEx service restrictions support.

GeographicalValidity.description: Describes the geographical validity of a product. Includes information on ServiceJourneys, PointToPointValidity and ZonalValidity. In cases of replacement transport, these fields describe the replacement journey.

serviceJourneys.description: Service journeys where this product is valid.

GeographicalValidityCovered.description: Describes the geographical validity covered by the recommendation.

coversEntireJourney.description: Indicates whether the geographical validity covers the entire journey or not.

serviceJourneys.description: The service journeys this geographical validity applies to.

userProfiles.description: User profiles and their required number of travellers in the group.

NamedReference.description: A simple reference with id and name.

id.description: The id of an offer. This id will be referenced in recommendations where there are "offersToBuy". Also, the offerId can be used to obtain the original offer-structure from v1.

name.description: The name of the SalesPackage that this OfferSummary represents.

preassignedProducts.description: All mandatory products that give the buyer a right to travel is found here.

optionalProductsSelectableIds.description: This field contains an array of selectableId's to optional products associated with an offer. The optional products are found in the field "optionalProducts" in the search response.

travellerMapping.description: Mapping of which travellers this offer applies to.

available.description: Number of this offer available to buy at this point in time.

eligibleForAccrualInPrograms.description: Buying this offer may give points in these personalisation programs.

availablePrograms.description: The customer may join the following programs to get points from buying this offer. It is expected that the caller does work to add the customer to the program.

OfferToBuy.description: Describes which offer to buy and how many of this offer to buy to satisfy a recommendation.

id.description: Id of the offer to buy.

numberToBuy.description: Number of this offer to buy.

selectableProductIds.description: List of selectableIds of supplement products which upgrades a product.

possibleTravellerIds.description: One possible grouping of travellers for the number of offers to buy.

OptionalProduct.description: Representation of a optional product that can be selected together with mandatory products in an offer.

selectableId.description: This is the id that is referred to from the OfferSummary's optionalProductsSelectableId's. It is also the id used when reserving the offer in later steps.

discountRights.description: Optional discounts applied to this product.

available.description: How many of this optional product is available to buy at this point in time.

supplementProductType.description: Describes what type of supplement product this is. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of SupplementProductTypeEnumeration at Entur.

OrganisationSummary.description: id and and name of an organisation.

PointToPointValidity.description: Start and stop places where the product is valid.

PreassignedProduct.description: Representation of a mandatory product that is included in an offer.

id.description: The id if the preassigned product.

version.description: The version of the preassigned product.

name.description: The name of the preassigned product.

description.description: The description of the preassigned product.

discountRights.description: Optional discounts applied to this product.

Price.description: Price with currency and optional VAT information for this element.

infoLink.description: URL to information about the loyalty program.

paused.description: Whether accrual for this program is currently paused.

infoLink.description: URL to information about the loyalty program.

PropertiesSummary.description: Summary of properties for a product. The properties field contains all necessary information about a product. Here you will find accommodations, baggageTypes, fareClass, userProfiles and more.

isExchangeable.description: Whether the ticket can be exchanged for a different departure.

isRefundable.description: Whether the ticket can be refunded.

accommodations.description: Accommodation facilities available per service journey.

items.description: Type of baggage. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of BaggageTypeEnumeration at Entur. Related to but may include more than 'BaggageTypeEnum'.

duration.description: Validity duration of the product, formatted according to ISO-8601.

items.description: A type of FareClass. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of FareClassEnumeration at Entur. Related to but may include more than 'FareClassEnum'.

durationType.description: Validity duration. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of UsageValidityTypeEnumeration at Entur. Related to but may include more than 'DurationTypeEnum'.

items.description: Nuisance facility for the product. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of NuisanceFacilityEnumeration at Entur.

id.description: Unique identifier of a recommendation within this response.

offersToBuy.description: Describes which offer to buy and how many of this offer to buy to satisfy a recommendation.

combineWithToCoverEntireJourney.description: List of RecommendationCombination covering remaining parts of the journey. The current recommendation can be combined with one of these to cover the entire journey.

RecommendationCombination.description: A combination of recommendations that together cover the entire journey.

recommendationsToCoverEntireJourney.description: You must select all recommendations in the list to cover the geographical validity.

items.description: Id of the recommendation(s) to select.

RecommendationCombination.title: RecommendationCombination

RecommendationResult.description: A set of recommendations matching the provided recommendation configuration.

coveringEntireJourney.description: Recommendations that cover the entire journey.

coveringPartOfJourney.description: Recommendations that cover part of the journey. Use `combineWithToCoverEntireJourney` when available to build recommendations to achieve full journey coverage.

reservingRequirement.description: Indicates requirements for reservation. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of ReservationEnumeration at Entur.

seatMapIsAvailable.description: Whether a seat map is available for seat selection on this service journey.

TravellerMappingSummary.description: A specification of which travellers can use an offer, along with limitations on the number of travellers that must be selected from the group for the OFFER to be valid.

maxNumberOfTravellers.description: The maximum number of travellers that can be selected from the group.

minNumberOfTravellers.description: The minimum number of travellers that can be selected from the group.

userType.description: A type of person. An offer for userType=CHILD, will naturally be different than an offer for userType=ADULT. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of UserTypeEnumeration at Entur. Related to but may include more than 'UserTypeEnum'.

TypeOfRecommendationEnum.description: Describes the degree of flexibility in a recommendation (refundable vs non-refundable, exchangeable vs non-exchangeable). Whether the recommendation is the CHEAPEST - regardless of flexibility, or whether the recommendation is for a specified product.

UnavailableProduct.description: Representation of a product that is unavailable, but would have been included in an offer if available.

id.description: NeTEx ID of the unavailable product.

name.description: Human readable name for the product.

unavailableStatus.description:
Status of why a product is unavailable.
 NOT_IN_PURCHASE_WINDOW - Product is outside of window where it can be purchased.
 NOT_YET_AVAILABLE - The product is not available yet, no further information is specified
 NO_QUOTAS_DEFINED - The product requires quotas to be purchased, but no quotas are defined yet.
NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE - The product is no longer available for purchase, no further information is specified.
SOLD_OUT - The product has no more seats or quotas available for sale.
CLOSED - The product is closed for sale.

items.description: Accommodation facility. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of AccommodationFacilityEnumeration at Entur. Related to but may include more than 'AccommodationFacilityEnum'.
A type of FareClass. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of FareClassEnumeration at Entur. Related to but may include more than 'FareClassEnum'.

isExchangeable.description: Whether the product would have been exchangeable.

isRefundable.description: Whether the product would have been refundable.

numberOfPeople.description: Number of travellers required for this user profile in the group.

UserProfileSummary.description: id, version, name and user type of a user.

userType.description: A type of person. An offer for userType=CHILD, will naturally be different than an offer for userType=ADULT. Compatible with the current NeTEx implementation of UserTypeEnumeration at Entur. Related to but may include more than 'UserTypeEnum'.

ZonalValidity.description: Describes zones where a product is valid. Either a specific list of from, to and viaZones, or a reference to a GroupOfTariffZones.

fromZone.description: Zone at the start of the journey.

toZone.description: Zone at the end of the journey.

viaZones.description: Unordered list of valid fare zones through which the trip traverses.

groupOfTariffZones.description: Reference to a group of fare zones. The offer is valid through all of the zones in this group.
